name: kiro-crew-bridge
description: Local, user-authorized Kiro Crew dispatch with receipt tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch bounded local Crew work with receipts.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local Kiro Crew gateway for explicitly authorized, bounded delegation. It keeps native Crew approvals in force, records idempotent receipts, and exposes only jobs created through this bridge.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my local Kiro Crew gateway is ready.
Delegate this bounded task to Kiro Crew after I authorize it.
Check the status of this Kiro Crew bridge receipt.
